About Diana Tours

A Masaka-born travel company showing visitors the real Uganda.

Our story

Diana Tours and Travel began with one van and a love for Uganda's lakes, forests and people. Today we host families, couples, students and groups from across the world and the region.

Our promise is simple: honest advice, safe travel and trips that give back to the communities we pass through.

  • Locally owned in Masaka
  • Small groups and private tours
  • Responsible, community-first tourism

What we stand for

Frequently asked questions

How do I book a tour?

Message us on WhatsApp, use the contact form or call 0761 772 656. We confirm availability and share a quote.

Do you pick up from Entebbe airport?

Yes. Airport pick-up and transfers to Masaka or any lodge are available.

Can I customise a package?

Absolutely. Every package can be shortened, extended or mixed with another.
